mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that triggers equity selling pressure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE increases by >0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and industrial production index signal an overheating economy where aggressive monetary tightening outweighs supply growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising FEDFUNDS and rising INDPRO fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of 60-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: Residential investment (HOUST) exceeding 1200.0 thousand units signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates robust economic activity that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when RSAFS increases sequentially for three periods.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% triggers expectations of aggressive Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as bond yields rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production and employment growth signal economic weakness where labor market stress amplifies equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of falling INDPRO and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of 5-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0.
